# Beautiful UI attribution

Source: https://www.beautifului.dev/ and https://github.com/slev12397/beautiful-ui

The Thinking State registry component is retained in `thinking-state.json`.
`src/components/ThinkingTrace.jsx` adapts its expandable step layout to real
FastAPI events rather than simulated timers. `src/foundation.css` adapts the
site's foundation styles with local shadow tokens. The MIT license is retained
in `BEAUTIFUL-UI-LICENSE`.
